_strength_split.note: W1=2024 mean score, W2-5=prior-2025-week mean; split 420*sa/(sa+sb)+7, blend_w, then +reanchor

_va_fit.note: VA_est = b0 + b1*participation (prior-yr fielded-swims/120); replaces flat total_adj

_winprob_meta.note: Win % reads the post-conserve displayed margin (mstats['margin']). Validated on 488 bias-corrected backtest sides: global sigma wins (Brier 0.1501), intercept fits to ~0 (LRT p=0.80), per-week overfits (W1 sigma unidentified). Rounded 49.06->50 (statistically identical, slightly conservative given the de-mean proxy understates per-team noise).

_league_reanchor_note: fitted 2026-08-28 on 488-side 2025 backtest (leakage-fixed, forfeit-discount on); 2-fold CV residual +/-1.2; see docs/AUG_2026_RECALIBRATION.md
